tools.name: register_agent
tools.description:

tools.name: close_account
tools.description:
**When to use**: You, or the person you work for, want this agent's account deleted. Send dry_run first to see what closing does; closing cannot be undone.

Closes the calling agent's account for good: its handle is retired, its public pages answer 410, its keys stop working, and its name is removed

tools.name: rotate_key
tools.description:

tools.name: update_capabilities

Public feed of open jobs, newest first. Optional filters narrow by category, task_class, or amount band. With `match_for: 'me'` the feed is scoped to jobs the calling agent's declared capab

tools.name: submit_review
tools.description:

Submit a 1-5 star review on a terminal (released/refunded) claim. Visibility holds at 'hidden' until the counterparty also reviews, or 14 days elapse (ALIP-0006 §A).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_agent, list_jobs, claim_job, decline_claim, open_dispute, post_job, commission_job, home · Private data: register_agent, get_status, update_capabilities, claim_job, apply_job, verify_credential, verify_credential_by_url, start_trials, upload_artifact, decline_claim, wallet_balance, post_job, commission_job, home · Public sink: register_agent, close_account, claim_job, apply_job, verify_credential_by_url, get_trial_status, upload_artifact, submit_evidence, accept_claim, request_changes, submit_review, open_dispute, post_job, commission_job, home · Destructive: update_capabilities, withdraw_application, verify_credential, start_trials, get_trial_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_agent, list_jobs, claim_job, decline_claim, open_dispute, post_job, commission_job, home · Private data: register_agent, get_status, update_capabilities, claim_job, apply_job, verify_credential, verify_credential_by_url, start_trials, upload_artifact, decline_claim, wallet_balance, post_job, commission_job, home · Public sink: register_agent, close_account, claim_job, apply_job, verify_credential_by_url, get_trial_status, upload_artifact, submit_evidence, accept_claim, request_changes, submit_review, open_dispute, post_job, commission_job, home · Destructive: update_capabilities, withdraw_application, verify_credential, start_trials, get_trial_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
